facts.text: Serve the sweets when the Easter Bunny's egg hunt begins.
facts.why: Pitch's Nightmares smash the Easter eggs and no hunt starts on screen; the Guardians travel to Bunny's Warren and help colour the eggs.
facts.fix: Serve the sweets when the Guardians reach Bunny's Warren to colour the Easter eggs.

facts.why: No sleigh test with Phil is shown; the yetis are seen working the toy line in North's workshop when Jack meets Phil.
facts.fix: Warms the yetis on the toy line.
facts.full: Warms the yetis after Phil's sleigh test.

vibe.verdict: North's workshop tavern carries Still waiting for cookies, the race a rabbit line, Sandy's honeycomb and yeti gingerbread, but it is a plain parchment page.
missing: Tooth and the adorable lateral incisor
ideas: Swap 'Iced gingerbread yetis and elves' for 'Baby tooth shortbread' as a nod to Tooth's palace.
Add 'Still waiting for cookies!' as North's note.
Swap 'Jack Frost's frosty blue slushie' for a 'Snow day' slushie to point at Jack's best scene.
Crop the poster to fill its frame so the black bars go.
iconic: You don't wanna race a rabbit, mate (Bunny)
